body: The search label no longer uses the code font, is this intentional?

I'm getting errors when changing theme setting with replace results open:
`ERROR: scene\gui\tree.cpp:1444 - Index p_index = -1 is out of bounds (cells[p_column].buttons.size() = 2)`

I think this needs to use column 1 in `get_button_by_id`, and maybe in the one above as well, but not sure.

I find there is no difference to particularly set search label font/font_size. And this label is in the same row with some other controls like _status_label, _keep_results_button, _refresh_button, _cancel_button whose font/font_size is not set particularly. So I remove this to let them more consistent.
And maybe the error you saw is realted to #112718.
I have changed column to 1. Could you check this again?
